apple_scab.name: Apple Scab
apple_scab.description: Fungal disease causing dark, scabby lesions on leaves and fruit.
apple_scab.treatment: Apply fungicides (captan, mancozeb) during spring. Remove fallen leaves. Prune for air circulation.
apple_scab.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Maintain good sanitation. Apply preventive fungicide sprays.

apple_black_rot.name: Apple Black Rot
apple_black_rot.description: Causes leaf spots, fruit rot, and cankers on branches.
apple_black_rot.treatment: Prune infected branches. Remove mummified fruit. Apply captan or thiophanate-methyl.
apple_black_rot.prevention: Remove dead wood and mummified fruit. Maintain tree vigor through proper fertilization.

apple_cedar_rust.name: Cedar Apple Rust
apple_cedar_rust.description: Orange-yellow spots on leaves, requires both apple and cedar/juniper hosts.
apple_cedar_rust.treatment: Apply myclobutanil or mancozeb at pink bud stage. Remove nearby juniper hosts if possible.
apple_cedar_rust.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Remove eastern red cedar within 2 miles if feasible.

cherry_powdery_mildew.name: Cherry Powdery Mildew
cherry_powdery_mildew.description: White powdery coating on leaves, can cause leaf curl and fruit cracking.
cherry_powdery_mildew.treatment: Apply sulfur-based fungicides or myclobutanil. Improve air circulation.
cherry_powdery_mildew.prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation. Prune for airflow. Apply preventive sprays.

corn_cercospora.name: Gray Leaf Spot
corn_cercospora.description: Rectangular gray-brown lesions on leaves, major yield reducer.
corn_cercospora.treatment: Apply strobilurin or triazole fungicides at VT-R1. Rotate crops.
corn_cercospora.prevention: Plant resistant hybrids. Rotate with non-host crops. Reduce residue through tillage.

corn_common_rust.name: Common Rust
corn_common_rust.description: Small, circular to elongated brown pustules on both leaf surfaces.
corn_common_rust.treatment: Apply fungicides if detected before tasseling. Usually not economically damaging.
corn_common_rust.prevention: Plant resistant hybrids. Early planting reduces risk.

corn_northern_leaf_blight.name: Northern Leaf Blight
corn_northern_leaf_blight.description: Long, elliptical gray-green lesions on leaves, can reduce yield 30-50%.
corn_northern_leaf_blight.treatment: Apply foliar fungicides (azoxystrobin, propiconazole) at first sign.
corn_northern_leaf_blight.prevention: Plant resistant hybrids. Rotate crops. Manage crop residue.

grape_black_rot.name: Grape Black Rot
grape_black_rot.description: Brown circular lesions on leaves, fruit shrivels into hard black mummies.
grape_black_rot.treatment: Apply mancozeb or myclobutanil from bud break. Remove mummified fruit.
grape_black_rot.prevention: Sanitation — remove all mummies and infected debris. Canopy management for airflow.

grape_esca.name: Grape Esca (Black Measles)
grape_esca.description: Tiger-stripe pattern on leaves, dark spots on berries. Chronic trunk disease.
grape_esca.treatment: No cure. Trunk surgery and wound protection. Remove severely affected vines.
grape_esca.prevention: Protect pruning wounds with fungicide paste. Avoid large pruning cuts. Late pruning.

grape_leaf_blight.name: Grape Leaf Blight (Isariopsis)
grape_leaf_blight.description: Angular dark brown spots on leaves, premature defoliation.
grape_leaf_blight.treatment: Apply mancozeb or copper-based fungicides. Remove infected leaves.
grape_leaf_blight.prevention: Good canopy management. Avoid overhead irrigation. Sanitation.

peach_bacterial_spot.name: Peach Bacterial Spot
peach_bacterial_spot.description: Water-soaked lesions on leaves, cracked/pitted fruit.
peach_bacterial_spot.treatment: Copper sprays in dormant season. Oxytetracycline during growing season.
peach_bacterial_spot.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Avoid overhead irrigation. Windbreaks reduce spread.

pepper_bacterial_spot.name: Pepper Bacterial Spot
pepper_bacterial_spot.description: Small, water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit, raised and scabby.
pepper_bacterial_spot.treatment: Copper-based bactericides. Remove infected plants. Avoid working in wet fields.
pepper_bacterial_spot.prevention: Use disease-free seed/transplants. Crop rotation (2-3 years). Avoid overhead irrigation.

potato_early_blight.name: Potato Early Blight
potato_early_blight.description: Concentric ring 'target' lesions on lower leaves first.
potato_early_blight.treatment: Apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb. Maintain plant vigor with adequate fertilization.
potato_early_blight.prevention: Crop rotation. Adequate irrigation. Plant certified disease-free seed.

potato_late_blight.name: Potato Late Blight
potato_late_blight.description: Water-soaked lesions, white mold on underside. The Irish Famine disease. Spreads rapidly.
potato_late_blight.treatment: Apply metalaxyl or cymoxanil IMMEDIATELY. Destroy infected plants. Protect neighbors.
potato_late_blight.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Eliminate cull piles. Monitor weather forecasts for blight conditions.

squash_powdery_mildew.name: Squash Powdery Mildew
squash_powdery_mildew.description: White powdery spots on upper leaf surface, can cover entire leaf.
squash_powdery_mildew.treatment: Apply potassium bicarbonate, sulfur, or myclobutanil. Neem oil for organic management.
squash_powdery_mildew.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Space plants for airflow. Avoid overhead watering.

strawberry_leaf_scorch.name: Strawberry Leaf Scorch
strawberry_leaf_scorch.description: Small purple spots that enlarge and merge, giving scorched appearance.
strawberry_leaf_scorch.treatment: Apply fungicides after harvest. Remove old leaves. Renovate beds.
strawberry_leaf_scorch.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Proper spacing. Remove infected leaves promptly.

tomato_bacterial_spot.name: Tomato Bacterial Spot
tomato_bacterial_spot.description: Small, dark, water-soaked spots on leaves, stems, and fruit.
tomato_bacterial_spot.treatment: Copper sprays + mancozeb. Remove severely infected plants.
tomato_bacterial_spot.prevention: Use disease-free transplants. Avoid overhead irrigation. Rotate crops 2-3 years.

tomato_early_blight.name: Tomato Early Blight
tomato_early_blight.description: Dark concentric ring lesions starting on lower leaves.
tomato_early_blight.treatment: Apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb. Stake plants. Remove lower infected leaves.
tomato_early_blight.prevention: Mulch to prevent soil splash. Crop rotation. Adequate spacing.

tomato_late_blight.name: Tomato Late Blight
tomato_late_blight.description: Large, dark, water-soaked lesions. White mold on leaf underside in humid conditions.
tomato_late_blight.treatment: Apply metalaxyl or cymoxanil immediately. Remove and destroy infected plants.
tomato_late_blight.prevention: Avoid planting near potatoes. Use resistant varieties. Monitor weather conditions.

tomato_leaf_mold.name: Tomato Leaf Mold
tomato_leaf_mold.description: Pale green-yellow spots on upper leaf, olive-green mold on underside.
tomato_leaf_mold.treatment: Improve ventilation. Apply fungicides. Reduce humidity in greenhouses.
tomato_leaf_mold.prevention: Resistant varieties. Proper greenhouse ventilation. Avoid leaf wetness.

tomato_septoria.name: Septoria Leaf Spot
tomato_septoria.description: Small circular spots with dark borders and tan centers, tiny black dots visible.
tomato_septoria.treatment: Apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb. Remove infected lower leaves.
tomato_septoria.prevention: Mulch. Avoid overhead watering. Crop rotation. Sanitize tools.

tomato_spider_mites.name: Spider Mite Damage
tomato_spider_mites.description: Fine stippling/yellowing of leaves. Tiny mites and webbing on leaf underside.
tomato_spider_mites.treatment: Spray with miticides (abamectin) or insecticidal soap. Strong water spray to dislodge.
tomato_spider_mites.prevention: Avoid dusty conditions. Maintain humidity. Encourage predatory mites.

tomato_target_spot.name: Tomato Target Spot
tomato_target_spot.description: Brown spots with concentric rings on leaves, fruit, and stems.
tomato_target_spot.treatment: Apply azoxystrobin or chlorothalonil. Remove lower infected foliage.
tomato_target_spot.prevention: Staking. Mulching. Crop rotation. Adequate plant spacing.

tomato_yellow_leaf_curl.name: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus
tomato_yellow_leaf_curl.description: Severe leaf curling, yellowing, stunting. Transmitted by whiteflies. No cure.
tomato_yellow_leaf_curl.treatment: Remove infected plants immediately. Control whitefly vectors with imidacloprid or reflective mulch.
tomato_yellow_leaf_curl.prevention: Plant resistant varieties (Ty genes). Whitefly management. Use insect-proof netting in nurseries.

tomato_mosaic_virus.name: Tomato Mosaic Virus
tomato_mosaic_virus.description: Mottled light/dark green mosaic pattern on leaves. Distorted growth.
tomato_mosaic_virus.treatment: No cure. Remove infected plants. Disinfect tools with 10% bleach between plants.
tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Use resistant varieties (Tm-2 gene). Disease-free seed. Sanitize hands and tools.

cassava_mosaic.name: Cassava Mosaic Disease
cassava_mosaic.description: Yellow-green mosaic pattern, leaf distortion, stunted growth. Major threat to food security.
cassava_mosaic.treatment: No cure. Remove infected plants. Use clean planting material from certified sources.
cassava_mosaic.prevention: Plant resistant varieties (TME 419, IITA improved). Whitefly control. Phytosanitation.

cassava_bacterial_blight.name: Cassava Bacterial Blight
cassava_bacterial_blight.description: Angular leaf spots, wilting, stem exudate. Can cause complete defoliation.
cassava_bacterial_blight.treatment: Remove and burn infected plants. Use disease-free cuttings.
cassava_bacterial_blight.prevention: Resistant varieties. Crop rotation. Avoid planting during wet season onset.

cassava_green_mottle.name: Cassava Green Mottle
cassava_green_mottle.description: Mild green mottling of leaves. Less severe than mosaic but reduces yield.
cassava_green_mottle.treatment: Remove severely affected plants. Use clean planting material.
cassava_green_mottle.prevention: Use virus-free cuttings. Monitor for whiteflies.

cassava_brown_streak.name: Cassava Brown Streak Disease
cassava_brown_streak.description: Yellow patches on leaves, brown necrotic rot in roots. The 'silent killer' — roots rot from inside.
cassava_brown_streak.treatment: No cure. Harvest early before root necrosis advances. Use clean planting material.
cassava_brown_streak.prevention: Plant tolerant varieties. Use virus-indexed planting material. Whitefly management.

mango_anthracnose.name: Mango Anthracnose
mango_anthracnose.description: Black spots on leaves, flowers, and fruit. Major post-harvest disease worldwide.
mango_anthracnose.treatment: Apply copper fungicides or mancozeb during flowering. Hot water treatment post-harvest (52°C, 5 min).
mango_anthracnose.prevention: Prune for airflow. Avoid overhead irrigation. Harvest during dry weather.

mango_powdery_mildew.name: Mango Powdery Mildew
mango_powdery_mildew.description: White powdery growth on leaves, flowers, and young fruit. Causes flower/fruit drop.
mango_powdery_mildew.treatment: Apply sulfur or triazole fungicides at first sign. Spray during flowering season.
mango_powdery_mildew.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Good spacing for airflow. Timely fungicide application.

mango_sooty_mold.name: Mango Sooty Mold
mango_sooty_mold.description: Black sooty coating on leaves and fruit, grows on honeydew from sap-sucking insects.
mango_sooty_mold.treatment: Control the insects (scale, mealybugs, hoppers) first. Wash off mold with water + mild soap.
mango_sooty_mold.prevention: Control sap-sucking insects. Prune dense canopy. Ant management (ants farm the insects).

banana_sigatoka.name: Black Sigatoka
banana_sigatoka.description: Dark leaf streaks that expand and kill leaves. Reduces photosynthesis, premature ripening.
banana_sigatoka.treatment: Systemic fungicides (propiconazole, azoxystrobin) in rotation. Remove infected leaves.
banana_sigatoka.prevention: Resistant varieties (FHIA hybrids). Deleafing. Proper drainage. Avoid overcrowding.

banana_fusarium_wilt.name: Fusarium Wilt (Panama Disease TR4)
banana_fusarium_wilt.description: Yellowing and wilting of older leaves. Internal vascular browning. NO CURE. Soil persists 30+ years.
banana_fusarium_wilt.treatment: NO CHEMICAL TREATMENT EXISTS. Destroy infected plants + surrounding 5m. Quarantine the area.
banana_fusarium_wilt.prevention: Biosecurity — clean boots, tools, machinery. Plant resistant varieties. Do NOT move soil.

banana_bunchy_top.name: Banana Bunchy Top Virus
banana_bunchy_top.description: Leaves become progressively shorter, bunched at top. Dark green streaks on petioles. No fruit.
banana_bunchy_top.treatment: No cure. Remove and destroy infected plants + all suckers. Inject with herbicide to ensure death.
banana_bunchy_top.prevention: Use virus-free planting material. Control aphid vector (Pentalonia nigronervosa). Quarantine.

coffee_rust.name: Coffee Leaf Rust (Roya)
coffee_rust.description: Orange-yellow powdery spots on leaf underside. Causes premature defoliation, 70-80% yield loss in epidemics.
coffee_rust.treatment: Apply copper fungicides or triazoles (cyproconazole). Start at first sign. 3-4 applications per season.
coffee_rust.prevention: Plant resistant varieties (Castillo, Colombia, Cenicafe 1). Shade management. Balanced fertilization.

coffee_cercospora.name: Coffee Brown Eye Spot
coffee_cercospora.description: Circular spots with gray center and brown border on leaves. Affects cherries too.
coffee_cercospora.prevention: Adequate shade. Balanced fertilization. Good drainage.

healthy.name: Healthy
healthy.description: No disease detected. The leaf appears healthy.
healthy.prevention: Continue good agricultural practices: proper nutrition, irrigation, and monitoring.
